jobs.title: 3D Artist (weapon skins)
jobs.description: HyperHug is an international game development studio specializing in the shooter genre. Our main office is based in Cyprus, but our talented team works remotely from around the world. We’re developing Oxide: Survival Island , an immersive multiplayer survival shooter for mobile platforms, and we’re always looking for motivated individuals who want to grow with us, contribute their creativity, and help shape the future of our games. As a 3D Artist, you will specialize in creating high-quality, realistic textures and skin variations for weapons and in-game props. You will work closely with the design and development teams to create compelling, visually appealing 3D assets that enhance player immersion and drive gameplay mechanics. What You’ll Be Doing: Create high-quality, realistic textures and skin variations for weapons and props, following the established visual style of Oxide. Prepare and polish weapon and prop models for texturing, ensuring clean UVs and proper asset workflow. Optimize textures and materials to ensure excellent performance on mobile devices. Work closely with the art lead to maintain visual consistency across all skins and materials. Iterate on feedback quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced production environment. Collaborate with developers and technical artists to ensure smooth integration of assets into the game engine. What We Expect From You: 1,5+ year of experience in 3D art in GameDev. Solid understanding of realistic texturing, including materials, roughness, dirt, and wear. Proficiency with Substance Painter, Photoshop, and at least one 3D modeling package (Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max). Basic knowledge of optimization techniques for mobile platforms. Ability to follow art direction and adapt to an existing visual style. Portfolio demonstrating prop and weapon texturing (skins, materials, or similar work). English - B1+ level, Russian - C1 level. Bonus If You Have: Familiarity with Unity or other mobile game engines. Understanding of PBR

jobs.description: Bigfish is op zoek naar jou! Een enthousiaste stagiair Illustratie/design. Wil jij meewerken aan het ontwikkelen van illustraties en visuele concepten? Als stagiair bij Bigfish ben je echt onderdeel van het team en kun je waardevolle ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector. Let op: deze stage is uitsluitend bedoeld voor studenten die tijdens de stageperiode staan ingeschreven aan een mbo- of hbo-opleiding. Sollicitaties van afgestudeerden kunnen we helaas niet in behandeling nemen. Taken Wat ga je doen? Ondersteunen bij het maken van illustraties, (interactieve) infographics en storyboards voor animatieprojecten. Samenwerken in een team om ideeën visueel vorm te geven. Je leert hoe je ruwe concepten kunt omzetten in aantrekkelijke visuele designs. Je gaat ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector en leert communiceren in een ervaren team. Je volgt een relevante mbo- of hbo- opleiding in de richting van illustratie, grafisch ontwerp of een vergelijkbare creatieve studie. Je hebt een divers portfolio met verschillende illustratiestijlen en visuele uitingen die relevant zijn voor de commerciële markt. Je bent leergierig, creatief en kunt goed samenwerken in een team. Je hebt affiniteit met design en oog voor detail. Basiskennis van design software zoals Adobe Illustrator en Photoshop. Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van minimaal 4 maanden. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Een leerzame en inspirerende stageplek met een dynamisch team. De kans om werkervaring op te doen bij een van de marktleiders op het gebied van animatie. jobs.title: Front End Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them. You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. jobs.title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
jobs.description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répond

jobs.title: User Research UX Apprentice
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: The User Research team’s mission is to help everybody at Back Market get to know and love our users so that we can create great experiences for them. We gather insights about what users need through a range of qualitative and quantitative techniques and translate them into valuable information for the product and design team. As an User Research (UX) Apprentice, you will work on the e-commerce experience Back Market provides to its customers, using insights to provide actionable recommendations for improvements, as well as contributing to improve our research processes, tools, and communications. You will also work closely with our business and product teams to ensure a user -centered culture in our problem and solution definition. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Bring stakeholders (business people), designers, product owners and engineers together to build, maintain, and evolve a robust experience for Back Market’s customers Listen to business problems and helping craft action plans Conduct qualitative research to collect insights and build strong recommendations Launch quantitative studies to discover trends and validate the hypothesis Work closely with product designers to ensure that your recommendations have the maximum impact Present the results of your work

jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
